The Best Mex in Viet Nam
May 2023 • Couples
I used to go to Hanoi Taco Bar when it was located in the Old Quarter. This was my first visit to the new location (overlooking West Lake). It's hard to believe, but the food's even better than before! It's such a sweet spot, love the decor and ambiance. Beer, tequilla and the best steak burrito! The ceviche was outstanding. The chips freshly made--a variety of salsas. This is a must stop for anyone missing quality Mexican food!

Great Value and Tasty Food.
Dec 2019
This is a really good restaurant with tasty food. We weren't too hungry so ordered 3 tacos and a quesadilla to share. The food was of excellent quality and the flavours were extremely tasty. The Taco's are of a medium to smallish size so if you're particularly hungry I would advise to order more. I'd recommend you to sit on the outside balcony as you can really soak up the Hanoi atmosphere whilst enjoying your meal.
